items.snippet: Apple launched iOS 27 on September 14, but the new OS version was initially minimized in Settings while iOS 26.7 was spotlighted as the recommended update. But now following the release of iOS 27.0.1, that has officially changed. Over the last few years, Apple has started rolling out its major new iOS updates more gradually. For example, while iOS 27 officially became available to all users on September 14, it wasn’t featured as the default, top-level update in the Settings app. Instead, until very recently, users saw iOS 26.7 as the recommended update, while iOS 27 was minimized under a small ‘Also Available’ section in the Software Update screen. Apple does this because inevitably, despite a months-long beta process, there are often new bugs that emerge following the public launch. And the company wants the chance to address these before pushing the update to its full user base. But now with iOS 27.0.1 available, Apple has made iOS 27 the default update for users still on iOS 26. items.snippet: Microsoft made sending from email aliases generally available for Exchange Online on 7 October 2026, after a public preview that began in January 2022. items.title: What are Microsoft Execution Containers?
items.snippet: Microsoft Execution Containers (MXC) are generally available as a policy-driven execution layer for untrusted or model-generated workloads, including AI agents, plugins, and tools. You declare the files, network destinations, commands, and desktop access a workload may use, and MXC enforces that boundary on Windows 11, macOS, or Linux. The policy sits outside the workload, so generated code cannot add permissions the policy left out. Intune policy for MXC process containers, and Entra attribution that separates agent activity from the signed-in user, are still described as coming soon.
